theme: Scavenged leather and bone armor from the wasteland

armor.name: Wasteland Helm
armor.description: A makeshift helmet fashioned from scavenged metal and leather. Protects against skeleton strikes.

armor.name: Wasteland Chestguard
armor.description: Reinforced leather armor scavenged from the ruins. Offers decent protection.

armor.name: Wasteland Gloves
armor.description: Tough leather gloves with bone reinforcements. Protect hands during combat.

armor.name: Wasteland Greaves
armor.description: Sturdy leg guards made from scavenged materials. Built for survival.

armor.name: Wasteland Boots
armor.description: Worn but reliable boots. Countless survivors have walked this wasteland before you.
